podcast.body: Released in 1999, this album gained fame because one of its songs was featured in a Levi's advertisement. It showcased PPDLUX as a great DJ artist with innovative scratching techniques, featuring simple scratching with a very dry equalization. "PPDLUX en 1999 sacaba Super Sound, sobre Mardisco, se hacía famoso porque una de las canciones salía en un anuncio de Levis si no os recuerdo mal."
